tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an Assessment Order issued under Section 143(3) read with Section 144B of the Income-tax Act, 1961, in relation to the income tax return filed for Assessment Year 2024–25. The Assessing Officer has proposed certain additions to the returned income, resulting in a total tax demand of Rs. 1.28 crore, including interest.
tax_litigation.status: Based on the advice of tax advisors, the Company believes that the aforementioned demand is not maintainable and has filed an appeal against the said Order. Accordingly, there is no immediate impact on the financials, operations, or other activities of the Company on account of the aforesaid order.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Show Cause Notice received from the GST Department alleging short-payment of GST of (i) ₹16,41,145 on account of alleged non-fulfilment of conditions prescribed under Notification No. 40/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated 23rd October, 2017 and Notification No. 41/2017-Integrated Tax (Rate) dated 23rd October, 2017 in respect of certain supplies made to merchant exporters at concessional rate and (ii) short-payment of GST of ₹2,19,04,579, on account of alleged short declaration of quantity of black granite blocks dispatched during FY 2020-21 and FY 2021-22 together with applicable interest and penalty. The Company was evaluating the SCN and proposed to submit its reply.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of the Commissioner of Central Tax, Guntur Commissionerate, Central GST Sub-Commissionerate, Nellore
tax_litigation.status: The Company has submitted its reply to the Show Cause Notice on October 14, 2026. The SCN has not yet been adjudicated and the Company is awaiting an opportunity for personal hearing.

timeline.summary: On April 29, 2026, Pokarna re-appointed Rahul Jain as MD and Gautam Chand Jain as CMD for five-year terms.
On May 15, 2026, Pokarna received a ₹33.40 Cr demand notice from the Department of Mines and Geology, Andhra Pradesh, which the company intends to appeal.
On May 21, 2026, Pokarna informed the exchange that CRISIL reaffirmed bank loan facility ratings at CRISIL A-/Stable / A2+ for the company (₹34.98 Cr) and subsidiary PESL (₹651.52 Cr).
On 28 May 2026, Pokarna reported FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹80.61 Cr (down from ₹187.55 Cr) and recommended a ₹0.60 per share dividend.
